title: OpenExtensionDerivedUnitIsIso
statement: For a scheme X and open U with the specified derived categories, let E be the derived over-site equivalence to module sheaves on U.toScheme and R the composite of derived open restriction with E.functor. For every J left adjoint to R, every supplied adjunction adj : J ⊣ R, and every A in D(O_U), the unit component adj.unit.app A is an isomorphism.

source.place: Sheaves Tag 00A7 (4); Modules on Sites Tag 03DI; Cohomology Tags 08BS and 08BT. Mathlib CategoryTheory.Monad.Adjunction supplies fullyFaithfulLOfCompIsoId.

proof.text: Take the canonical ordinary extension-by-zero adjunction. Its unit is invertible. Apply the exact derived adjunction theorem to obtain an adjunction between its mapDerivedCategory functors. The composition and natural-isomorphism comparison maps identify derived extension followed by derived restriction with the identity. Mathlib fullyFaithfulLOfCompIsoId makes the derived left adjoint fully faithful.

Compose the inverse derived over-site equivalence with that fully faithful left adjoint. The composite is fully faithful and left adjoint to R; its unit is therefore invertible. The leftAdjointUniq unit comparison identifies its unit, composed with an invertible map, with the supplied adjunction unit.

theorem openExtension_derived_unit_isIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    let E := (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ E
    ∀ (J : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (adj : J ⊣ R) (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme), IsIso (adj.unit.app A)
